main_products: Kids' wear: woven jackets (ski, quilted, waterproof), jeans, cargo pants, skirts, party and casual dresses, boys' suits, uniforms
woven_evidence: Its product list is mostly woven: outerwear, denim, cargo pants, dresses and boys' suits. It also lists leggings and baby sets, which are likely knit.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The company's own page invites buyers to booth 1.1F01 at Phase 3 of the 139th Canton Fair, May 1-5, 2026.

notes: The only address it gives is an office in SOHO International Plaza, Nanjing, with no factory address. Sister Honry sites name JIANGSU SOHO HONRY IMPORT & EXPORT CO., LTD, which suggests it is the export arm of a trading group, so Layer 2 should check whether it owns a factory. It claims BSCI, SEDEX, SGS and OEKO-TEX but gives no certificate numbers. Contacts: jackeysun@honrykidswear.com and +86 13813357005 (WhatsApp).
